<p>I keep forgetting to make these blog posts on Fridays. Not a great sign but I think it&#39;s coming from laziness and stress more than anything else. I need to make time to hook up this website to a mailing list. I think not a lot of people seeing this website means that I don&#39;t have the same intention incentive to post.  </p>
<p>I&#39;ve been sad and mad and stressed recently, for seemingly little reason. There&#39;s a lot of tension at work right now- our management has been very dodgy about my team&#39;s (very reasonable) request for a wrap-up meeting summarizing this school year. We&#39;re finally getting it, but the team getting ready for that meeting means that there&#39;s a lot of negativity flying around the office. Productive negativity. But it still feels bad in my body and mind. I wonder if there&#39;s some other reason I&#39;m feeling off that will feel blindingly obvious in a month or a year.  </p>
<p>Meanwhile, my social life has been as lively as I need it to be. Last weekend Michelle and I went to a great board game night at Emma&#39;s, where I got to see Shane for the first time since leaving OSI. Then this weekend, Matt hosted a proper LA pool party in Monterey Park. Drinks and weed in great weather with attractive young people talking about their lives. And of course, awkwardness because not all of these people know each other. But I had a lovely time because I got to have an perfect ratio of talking to my friends and talking to strangers. So no awkwardness for me! Suck it, cool tatted up young people who I&#39;m sure also had a great time!  </p>
<p>Other life updates:</p>
<ul>
<li>Reception to The Messenger continues to be positive.</li>
<li>Writing the next comic has been a struggle but I&#39;m getting there I think.</li>
<li>I&#39;m exercising almost every day. I think I&#39;m starting to even look different, but that may be a placebo.</li>
</ul>
<p>I&#39;ll try to get back into the habit of posting Fridays next week.</p>
